source_text: Ostende faciem: sponsus faciem et vocem non penitus ignarus, sed intervallo caruerat. Desiderat sponsae verba et aspectum in loco secretiore, ubi reverentia velamen remittit.
pass_a_gloss: Show face: bridegroom face and voice not wholly unknowing, but by-interval had-lacked. He-desires of-bride words and appearance in place more-secret, where reverence veil sends-back.
pass_b_english: Show me your face: the Bridegroom is not wholly ignorant of face and voice, but by an interval he had gone without them. He desires the Bride’s words and appearance in a more secret place, where reverence lets the veil fall back.
